title: Community Exchange Day
label: SET 1
passageHtml:
Material A: Email

From: Ms. Ito
To: Student Volunteers
Subject: Community Exchange Day

Thank you for helping at Saturday’s event. Please arrive at Greenfield Community Center by 8:40 a.m. The doors open to visitors at 10:00, but we need time to prepare the rooms.

You may choose one of three jobs: welcoming visitors, helping at the international food tables, or supporting children’s activities. Students helping with food must attend a short safety briefing at 9:00 in Room B.

Lunch will be provided. Bring a reusable water bottle and wear comfortable shoes. The event ends at 3:30 p.m., and clean-up should finish by 4:00.

Material B: Volunteer Schedule

JobStartMain taskSpecial note
Welcome Desk9:30Give maps and answer questionsConfident spoken English helpful
Food Tables9:00Arrange food and explain dishesSafety briefing required
Children’s Area9:20Run games and craft activitiesMeet beside the stage

Material C: Group Chat

Mika: I need to leave by 3:40 because of basketball practice.
Leo: I’m good at speaking with people, but I can’t come before 9:15.
Sara: I want to learn about food from other countries. I can arrive at 8:30.

questions.question: Why must volunteers arrive before the doors open?
questions.evidence: The doors open to visitors at 10:00, but we need time to prepare the rooms.
questions.reason_ja: 来場者の入場前に会場準備をする必要があるためです。but の後ろに到着時刻が早い理由があります。

questions.question: Which job requires volunteers to receive special instructions?
questions.evidence: Students helping with food must attend a short safety briefing at 9:00 in Room B.
questions.reason_ja: food を担当する生徒には safety briefing が必要だとメールと表の両方に書かれています。

questions.question: Which job is most suitable for Leo?
questions.evidence: Welcome Desk starts at 9:30 and confident spoken English is helpful. Leo can arrive after 9:15 and is good at speaking with people.
questions.reason_ja: Leoは9時15分より前には来られません。9時30分開始で、会話力が役立つWelcome Deskが最適です。

questions.question: Why is Sara a good match for the Food Tables?
options: She wants to learn about international food and can attend the briefing
questions.answer: She wants to learn about international food and can attend the briefing
questions.evidence: Sara wants to learn about food from other countries and can arrive at 8:30; the briefing begins at 9:00.
questions.reason_ja: 関心と到着可能時刻の二つの条件を組み合わせて判断します。

questions.question: What problem does Mika have with the event schedule?
options: She cannot attend the food briefing
She may not be able to help with all of the clean-up
She cannot bring a water bottle
questions.answer: She may not be able to help with all of the clean-up
questions.evidence: Mika must leave by 3:40, while clean-up should finish by 4:00.
questions.reason_ja: イベント終了は3時30分ですが、片付けは4時までです。Mikaは3時40分に退出するため、最後まで片付けられない可能性があります。
